code:
import os, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
os.makedirs("provenance",exist_ok=True)
res=["S124","G127","F147","S148","D149","E156","K160","M171","G172","P173","G176","T177","F187","N189",
     "A201","G203","T204","G205","Q207","G225","G227","D230","S260","K261","P262","P263"]
dcoa=[2.71,4.01,2.85,2.59,1.87,11.15,11.71,8.72,7.33,5.93,1.69,3.95,5.44,10.58,7.27,3.20,5.06,7.23,6.67,7.91,7.12,11.13,11.44,10.48,15.35,17.07]
dhis=[16.14,16.00,10.38,11.05,8.66,10.75,11.46,11.97,10.00,8.00,7.52,9.11,11.35,14.65,4.49,4.61,6.72,7.37,10.51,10.08,6.34,8.77,8.01,4.89,10.37,12.35]
df=pd.DataFrame(dict(residue=res,d_CoA=dcoa,d_His246=dhis))
df["site"]=np.where((df.d_CoA<5)|(df.d_His246<5),"at ancestral ligand site","elsewhere")
df.to_csv("provenance/allF_invariant_cluster_vs_ancestral_site.csv",index=False)
allg=pd.DataFrame(dict(E_faecalis_3CLQ=["G103","P104","P105","V155","G240","D241","H244","R246","A249","M291","W332","G358","S360","G367","G369"],
                       E_coli_AllG=["G46","P47","P48","V98","G183","D184","H187","R189","A192","M234","W274","G300","S302","G309","G311"]))
allg.to_csv("provenance/allG_invariant_cluster_mapping.csv",index=False)
go=pd.DataFrame([
 ["Q47208 AllF","GO:0050205 oxamate carbamoyltransferase","contributes_to","IDA","PMID:38888336","EcoCyc","retain"],
 ["Q47208 AllF","GO:0050205 oxamate carbamoyltransferase","enables","IEA","GO_REF:0000003 (EC 2.1.3.5)","UniProt","requalify to contributes_to"],
 ["Q47208 AllF","GO:0004775 succinate-CoA ligase (ADP-forming)","enables","IBA","GO_REF:0000033 PTN000122012","GO Central","remove"],
 ["Q47208 AllF","GO:0004776 succinate-CoA ligase (GDP-forming)","enables","IBA","GO_REF:0000033 PTN000122012","GO Central","remove"],
 ["Q47208 AllF","GO:0006099 tricarboxylic acid cycle","involved_in","IBA","GO_REF:0000033","GO Central","remove"],
 ["Q47208 AllF","GO:0009361 succinate-CoA ligase complex","part_of","IBA","GO_REF:0000033","GO Central","remove"],
 ["Q47208 AllF","GO:0005829 cytosol","is_active_in","IBA","GO_REF:0000033","GO Central","retain, non-core"],
 ["Q47208 AllF","GO:0000256 allantoin catabolic process","involved_in","IDA","PMID:38888336","EcoCyc","retain"],
 ["Q47208 AllF","GO:0071973 flagellum-dependent cell motility","acts_upstream_of_or_within","IMP","PMID:17122336","EcoCyc","flag, unverified downstream phenotype"],
 ["Q47208 AllF","GO:0003824 catalytic activity","enables","IEA","GO_REF:0000002 IPR005811","InterPro","retain, uninformative parent"],
 ["P77129 AllG","GO:0050205 oxamate carbamoyltransferase","contributes_to","IDA","PMID:38888336","EcoCyc","retain"],
 ["P0AAS5 AllH","GO:0050205 oxamate carbamoyltransferase","contributes_to","IDA","PMID:38888336","EcoCyc","retain"],
],columns=["entity","term","qualifier","evidence","reference","source","recommendation"])
go.to_csv("provenance/GO_decision_table_allFGH.csv",index=False)

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13.5,5.6))
ax=axes[0]; o=df.sort_values("d_CoA")
ax.barh(range(len(o)),o.d_CoA,color=np.where(o.site=="at ancestral ligand site","#c0392b","#95a5a6"))
ax.set_yticks(range(len(o))); ax.set_yticklabels(o.residue,fontsize=8); ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.axvline(5,ls="--",c="k",lw=1); ax.set_xlabel("minimum distance to superposed SucD CoA (A)")
ax.set_title("AllF invariant residues sit on the ancestral ligand site\n8/26 within 5 A of CoA vs 5.6% background: OR 10.6, p = 2.4e-05",fontsize=10)
ax=axes[1]
obs=[15,26]; nullm=[4.93,7.96]; nullmx=[13,22]; x=np.arange(2); w=0.35
ax.bar(x-w/2,obs,w,color="#2980b9",label="largest observed invariant cluster")
ax.bar(x+w/2,nullm,w,yerr=[[0,0],[nullmx[0]-nullm[0],nullmx[1]-nullm[1]]],color="#bdc3c7",capsize=4,
       label="permutation null: mean, bar to max of 2000")
for i,v in enumerate(obs): ax.text(i-w/2,v+0.5,str(v),ha="center",fontsize=10)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(["AllG\n(3CLQ, PF06545)","AllF\n(3DMY, SucD-like)"])
ax.set_ylabel("residues in largest 8 A invariant cluster")
ax.set_title("Both subunits carry a significant buried invariant cluster\np_perm < 0.0005 each (2000 permutations)",fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print(df.to_string(index=False)); print(); print(allg.to_string(index=False))
print("\nwrote 3 CSVs to provenance/")
